summary: FingerMotion, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants to an institutional investor. The company sold 3,958,055 shares at $0.24 per share and pre-funded warrants for 12,708,611 shares at $0.2399 each, with a $0.0001 exercise price, raising approximately $4.0 million net. Proceeds are for general corporate and working capital purposes. The offering was made under an existing effective S-3 shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; no control change, premium, or unusual structure beyond the use of pre-funded warrants to limit beneficial ownership to 4.99%.
